CancelJob.name: CancelJob
CancelJob.doc: Cancels a job in an Batch job queue. Jobs that are in a SUBMITTED, PENDING, or RUNNABLE state are cancelled and the job status is updated to FAILED. A PENDING job is canceled after all dependency jobs are completed. Therefore, it may take longer than expected to cancel a job in PENDING status. When you try to cancel an array parent job in PENDING, Batch attempts to cancel all child jobs. The…

CreateComputeEnvironment.name: CreateComputeEnvironment
CreateComputeEnvironment.doc: Creates an Batch compute environment. You can create MANAGED or UNMANAGED compute environments. MANAGED compute environments can use Amazon EC2 or Fargate resources. UNMANAGED compute environments can only use EC2 resources. In a managed compute environment, Batch manages the capacity and instance types of the compute resources within the environment. This is based on the compute resource…

CreateJobQueue.name: CreateJobQueue
CreateJobQueue.doc: Creates an Batch job queue. When you create a job queue, you associate one or more compute environments to the queue and assign an order of preference for the compute environments. You also set a priority to the job queue that determines the order that the Batch scheduler places jobs onto its associated compute environments. For example, if a compute environment is associated with more than one…

CreateQuotaShare.name: CreateQuotaShare
CreateQuotaShare.doc: Creates an Batch quota share. Each quota share operates as a virtual queue with a configured compute capacity, resource sharing strategy, and borrow limits.

CreateServiceEnvironment.name: CreateServiceEnvironment
CreateServiceEnvironment.doc: Creates a service environment for running service jobs. Service environments define capacity limits for specific service types such as SageMaker Training jobs.

DeleteComputeEnvironment.name: DeleteComputeEnvironment
DeleteComputeEnvironment.doc: Deletes an Batch compute environment. Before you can delete a compute environment, you must set its state to DISABLED with the UpdateComputeEnvironment API operation and disassociate it from any job queues with the UpdateJobQueue API operation. Compute environments that use Fargate resources must terminate all active jobs on that compute environment before deleting the compute environment. If…

DeleteJobQueue.name: DeleteJobQueue
DeleteJobQueue.doc: Deletes the specified job queue. You must first disable submissions for a queue with the UpdateJobQueue operation. All jobs in the queue are eventually terminated when you delete a job queue. It's not necessary to disassociate compute environments from a queue before submitting a DeleteJobQueue request.

DeleteQuotaShare.name: DeleteQuotaShare
DeleteQuotaShare.doc: Deletes the specified quota share. You must first disable submissions for the share by updating the state to DISABLED using the UpdateQuotaShare operation. All jobs in the share are eventually terminated when you delete a quota share.

DeleteSchedulingPolicy.name: DeleteSchedulingPolicy
DeleteSchedulingPolicy.doc: Deletes the specified scheduling policy. You can't delete a scheduling policy that's used in any job queues.

DeleteServiceEnvironment.name: DeleteServiceEnvironment
DeleteServiceEnvironment.doc: Deletes a Service environment. Before you can delete a service environment, you must first set its state to DISABLED with the UpdateServiceEnvironment API operation and disassociate it from any job queues with the UpdateJobQueue API operation.

DeregisterJobDefinition.name: DeregisterJobDefinition
DeregisterJobDefinition.doc: Deregisters an Batch job definition. Job definitions are permanently deleted after 180 days.

DescribeComputeEnvironments.name: DescribeComputeEnvironments
DescribeComputeEnvironments.doc: Describes one or more of your compute environments. If you're using an unmanaged compute environment, you can use the DescribeComputeEnvironment operation to determine the ecsClusterArn that you launch your Amazon ECS container instances into.

DescribeConsumableResource.name: DescribeConsumableResource
DescribeConsumableResource.doc: Returns a description of the specified consumable resource.

DescribeJobDefinitions.name: DescribeJobDefinitions
DescribeJobDefinitions.doc: Describes a list of job definitions. You can specify a status (such as ACTIVE) to only return job definitions that match that status.

DescribeJobQueues.name: DescribeJobQueues
DescribeJobQueues.doc: Describes one or more of your job queues.

DescribeJobs.name: DescribeJobs
DescribeJobs.doc: Describes a list of Batch jobs.

DescribeQuotaShare.name: DescribeQuotaShare
DescribeQuotaShare.doc: Returns a description of the specified quota share.

DescribeSchedulingPolicies.name: DescribeSchedulingPolicies
DescribeSchedulingPolicies.doc: Describes one or more of your scheduling policies.

DescribeServiceEnvironments.name: DescribeServiceEnvironments
DescribeServiceEnvironments.doc: Describes one or more of your service environments.

DescribeServiceJob.name: DescribeServiceJob
DescribeServiceJob.doc: The details of a service job.

GetJobQueueSnapshot.name: GetJobQueueSnapshot
GetJobQueueSnapshot.doc: Provides a snapshot of job queue state, including ordering of RUNNABLE jobs, as well as capacity utilization for already dispatched jobs. The first 100 RUNNABLE jobs in the job queue are listed in order of dispatch. For job queues with an attached quota-share policy, the first RUNNABLE job in each quota share is also listed. Capacity utilization for the job queue is provided, as well as break…

ListConsumableResources.name: ListConsumableResources
ListConsumableResources.doc: Returns a list of Batch consumable resources.

ListJobs.name: ListJobs
ListJobs.doc: Returns a list of Batch jobs. You must specify only one of the following items: A job queue ID to return a list of jobs in that job queue A multi-node parallel job ID to return a list of nodes for that job An array job ID to return a list of the children for that job

ListJobsByConsumableResource.name: ListJobsByConsumableResource
ListJobsByConsumableResource.doc: Returns a list of Batch jobs that require a specific consumable resource.

ListQuotaShares.name: ListQuotaShares
ListQuotaShares.doc: Returns a list of Batch quota shares associated with a job queue.

ListSchedulingPolicies.name: ListSchedulingPolicies
ListSchedulingPolicies.doc: Returns a list of Batch scheduling policies.

ListServiceJobs.name: ListServiceJobs
ListServiceJobs.doc: Returns a list of service jobs for a specified job queue.

ListTagsForResource.name: ListTagsForResource
ListTagsForResource.doc: Lists the tags for an Batch resource. Batch resources that support tags are compute environments, jobs, job definitions, job queues, and scheduling policies. ARNs for child jobs of array and multi-node parallel (MNP) jobs aren't supported.

SubmitJob.name: SubmitJob
SubmitJob.doc: Submits an Batch job from a job definition. Parameters that are specified during SubmitJob override parameters defined in the job definition. vCPU and memory requirements that are specified in the resourceRequirements objects in the job definition are the exception. They can't be overridden this way using the memory and vcpus parameters. Rather, you must specify updates to job definition…

SubmitServiceJob.name: SubmitServiceJob
SubmitServiceJob.doc: Submits a service job to a specified job queue to run on SageMaker AI. A service job is a unit of work that you submit to Batch for execution on SageMaker AI.

TagResource.name: TagResource
TagResource.doc: Associates the specified tags to a resource with the specified resourceArn. If existing tags on a resource aren't specified in the request parameters, they aren't changed. When a resource is deleted, the tags that are associated with that resource are deleted as well. Batch resources that support tags are compute environments, jobs, job definitions, job queues, and scheduling policies. ARNs for…

TerminateJob.name: TerminateJob
TerminateJob.doc: Terminates a job in a job queue. Jobs that are in the STARTING or RUNNING state are terminated, which causes them to transition to FAILED. Jobs that have not progressed to the STARTING state are cancelled.

TerminateServiceJob.name: TerminateServiceJob
TerminateServiceJob.doc: Terminates a service job in a job queue.

UntagResource.name: UntagResource
UntagResource.doc: Deletes specified tags from an Batch resource.

UpdateServiceEnvironment.name: UpdateServiceEnvironment
UpdateServiceEnvironment.doc: Updates a service environment. You can update the state of a service environment from ENABLED to DISABLED to prevent new service jobs from being placed in the service environment.

UpdateServiceJob.name: UpdateServiceJob
UpdateServiceJob.doc: Updates the priority of a specified service job in an Batch job queue.
